# Drape Digital
> Drape Digital is a premium web design, development, and SEO agency. We build your website first — you only pay if you love it. Zero upfront cost, zero obligation.

## About
Drape Digital is a full-service digital agency based in Tetouan, Morocco, serving clients globally including the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, UAE, and Australia. We specialize in custom website design, React/Next.js development, SEO, off-page link building, local SEO, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO).

Our unique model: we build a fully functional demo of your website hosted on a private subdomain (yourbusiness.drape.digital) before you pay anything. You only commit if you love the result.

- Website: https://drape.digital
- Email: contact@drape.digital
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/drape.digital
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/drapedigital/

## How It Works
1. We analyze your current web presence and build a tailored design concept.
2. We build a fully functional demo site hosted at yourbusiness.drape.digital.
3. You review the live site on any device. If you love it, we finalize, migrate to your domain, and hand you the keys.
4. You only pay when you're satisfied.

## FAQ
- Do I pay before seeing my site? No. We build first, you pay if you love it.
- How long does it take? Working prototype within 72 hours. Full launch in 1–2 weeks.
- Do you guarantee SEO results? We implement best-practice SEO. Results vary, but our clients typically see measurable improvements within 60–90 days.
- What is white hat link building? Manual, editorial backlink placements on legitimate sites. No spam or PBNs. 100% Google-compliant.
- Can you rank us on ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews? Yes — through our GEO/AEO service starting at $499.
